name: framer-autoplay-carousel
title: Framer Autoplay Carousel
blurb: Auto-scrolling image carousel that pauses on hover with spring-based…
description: Full-width carousel that continuously scrolls through images with configurable interval. Pauses on hover, resumes when pointer leaves. Uses Framer Motion spring animation for smooth navigation.
use_when: Auto-rotating image galleries, testimonials, or logo walls with minimal interaction.
avoid_when: When users need full carousel control; auto-play can be distracting.
a11y: No keyboard navigation. Pause-on-hover improves pause-ability but doesn't offer fine control.
